summary: Prepares a V on the host: one run per requester at a time, superseded only by that requester's newer request, into a content-addressed cache shared per installation.

faults.when: Preparing this V needs WolvenKit; the request is suspended, not failed.
The request is outside the accepted character request versions.

lifetime: Per requester (a page's actor) and request key; the shared cache lives per installation fingerprint.

x-friction.gap: A page's newer request supersedes only that page's older one; the host run for a key is shared across pages.
x-friction.closes: Requests with requester identity and supersession scoped to the requester.
